Read all four current tag carriers: wireu/rfc1997_wellknown_test.go::TestWellKnownAllThreeOperationsImplemented and TestWellKnownIgnoresOtherReservedCommunities; reactor/rfc1997_forward_wellknown_test.go::TestForwardWellKnownNeedsNoOperatorPolicy and TestForwardOtherReservedCommunitiesReachExternalPeer. The reactor pair asserts an empty operator filter list, suppression of received NO_EXPORT, and delivery with NOPEER/BLACKHOLE/LLGR_STALE. Producers: wireu/wellknown.go::ScanWellKnown and AllowsEgressTo; reactor/forward_wellknown.go::scanWellKnownEgress and wellKnownAllowsEgress; reactor_api_forward.go::forwardUpdateSection consumes the decision before policy and sets withdrawal rather than advertising.
